name: agent-linux-control
description: Premium Linux desktop-control toolkit for coding agents: realtime observe/watch loops, mouse, keyboard, clipboard paste, browser launch, MCP, batched sequences, and readiness checks.

interface.shortDescription: Let coding agents operate Linux desktops through one CLI.
interface.longDescription: Installs a Linux desktop-control command and skill so Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, and other agents can observe screens, run realtime watch loops, move/click/type, paste reliably, launch browsers, execute batched action sequences, expose MCP tools, test Zen/browser workflows, and verify readiness on Fedora-like, Debian-like, Arch-like, Alpine, and Raspberry Pi/ARM Linux systems.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this Linux desktop is ready for OS-level control.
Capture the screen, inspect it, then click the focused app safely.
Install the Linux control helper and skill for this agent.
